title: Love a good parody, especially when it’s clever and hilarious #onewom...
transcript: I went to go see One Woman Show the other day and this show is freaking hilarious. One Woman show is a direct parody of, you guessed it, one woman shows, particularly shows like flee back. In One Woman Show we see Liz king's man put on her woman woman show entitled wild foul wild foul. Say that 5 times fast as she is getting ready to film it to try to present it to producers to try to get, you know, her own TV show. Similar to Flee Bag. This show is going to get a lot of comparisons to Kate, but I think ultimately they are very different. Kate more poked fun and observed the art of performing in itself. One Woman Show more pokes fun at the form of the one woman show and how women are presenting themselves in the shows that they're writing. I laughed literally start to finish. I thought the show was so freaking funny. And if you are a fan of shows like Fleabag, I cannot recommend this enough. It's just really good. Currently playing at the Greenwich House Theatre until August 11th, and I will say this does have some unique showtimes. Like there's a 6 PM show and a 9 or 09:15 show. And it's a one act, so if you got creative and found something in the vicinity you could potentially squeeze in an extra show in your day.
